detail.tone: Buyers were broad-based on Wednesday. The question for today is whether that breadth survives a softer global open.
watch: A US–Iran headline that moves crude sharply either way
How the market absorbs NSE’s ₹22,562 cr listing on the first day

top.title: NSE debuts on BSE at 10:00
more: Offer for sale by existing shareholders: NSE itself raises nothing
Price band ₹1,700–1,785; ~₹4.42 lakh cr valuation at the top end
₹6,746 cr anchor book: LIC, Goldman Sachs, Fidelity, GIC, ADIA, Norges
Retail demand muted: tighter F&O rules put derivatives revenue in question

top.title: Gift Nifty −138 pts after Wall St slide
top.line: Likely lower open after Wednesday’s +0.5% close
more: Wed close: Nifty 23,447 (+118), Sensex 74,828 (+299)
Metals led (+2%, Tata Steel, Hindalco); IT fell 1%
Midcaps +0.7%, smallcaps +0.9%: broad buying
Gift Nifty −138 pts points to a lower start as US stocks fell overnight

top.title: FIIs flip to buyers: +₹1,617 cr
top.line: Breaks the selling streak · DIIs also bought ₹2,342 cr on Wed
more: Sep 23: FIIs +₹1,617 cr, DIIs +₹2,342 cr (provisional cash)
Before this, FIIs sold in 8 of the prior 9 sessions
September FPI outflow was ₹23,676 cr through Sep 19
July and August were inflow months (+₹11,045 cr, +₹10,231 cr)

top.title: Crude pinned near $100
top.line: US–Iran talks are the swing factor for oil, rupee and OMCs
more: Brent hovering near $100 on hopes for US–Iran talks
Iran hinted it could reopen Hormuz within days if US eases military pressure
Rupee traded ~95.7–96.1 per dollar last week
High crude weighs on OMCs, paints, aviation; helps upstream producers

top.title: BDL wins ₹811 cr defence order
top.line: Exide’s Li-ion cell plant goes live · Fidelity buys ₹279 cr of Welspun Living
more: BDL: ₹810.79 cr Defence Ministry contract for SAT-SAAW equipment
Exide: Phase-I of its 6 GWh lithium-ion cell plant in Bengaluru commissioned
Welspun Living: Fidelity bought 1.30 cr shares (₹279 cr); promoter trust sold 2.45 cr (₹526 cr)
Max Estates: 9.76-acre Ghaziabad JDA, GDV ₹2,500–3,000 cr · Avantel: ₹177 cr Zetwerk order

sources.title: Business Standard — Stocks to watch, Sep 24

summary: Wednesday closed on a firm, broad note — small and midcaps outran the Nifty — but the overnight global tone has turned soft, so the day starts on the back foot.
